title: Innovative electrode designs for low-temperature electrochemical CO2 reduction with ampere-level performance
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,7792-7858
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE02225H, Review Article
Xiaofeng Ke, Weicong Xu, Chao Liu, Yakun Wang, Xiaozhong Huang, Rui Xiao, Xiaomin Xu, Tao Li, Zongping Shao
This review examines advanced electrode designs for low-temperature electrochemical CO2 reduction at ampere-level current densities, highlighting functional architectures and interface engineering to bridge lab-scale innovation and industrial use.
